posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of SEKISUI Aerospace ITAR Data on Darkweb A darkweb forum post alleges the theft and sale of 70 GB of sensitive engineering data belonging to SEKISUI Aerospace Corporation, a U.S.-based Tier 1 supplier for major defense contractors. The actor claims to possess export-controlled technical data, including engineering drawings, STEP files, and bills of materials related to Boeing 737 and 787 programs, as well as components for NASA, Lockheed Martin, and Northrop Grumman. According to the listing, the stolen package contains highly specific technical artifacts marked as “EXPORT CONTROLLED – EAR 9E991 / ITAR Technical Data.” The post enumerates the following contents: • Technical PDF files containing engineering drawings • Complete STEP files in AP242 format for CATIA V5-6R2022 and SolidWorks 2018–2024 • Full Bills of Materials with authentic Boeing part numbers • Complete tooling and fixture data for the Boeing 737 MAX Keel Skin Splice Strap, Boeing 787 Section 41 Nose, and interior panel assemblies • Material specifications including carbon fiber prepreg, thermoplastic PEI and PPS, aluminum 6061-T6, and titanium inserts • Tolerances down to ±0.0005 inch with GD&T in accordance with ASME Y14.5 • Three-dimensional models of assembly tools including drill jigs, trim fixtures, bonding fixtures, and all related bushings and locator hardware with real Carr Lane and McMaster-Carr part numbers • Process specification documents compliant with Boeing BAC requirements The threat actor is reportedly asking for $200,000 USD for the data, stating that the price can be negotiated. The data allegedly includes precision assembly tooling and thermoplastic components used in fuselage, wing, keel beam, and interior structures. Because the materials are subject to strict U.S. export controls under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), their unauthorized disclosure could carry significant legal and national security implications for the affected entities. SEKISUI Aerospace Corporation is a subsidiary of Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd., a major Japanese chemical manufacturer. As a direct supplier to Boeing and other critical defense primes, the company plays a vital role in the aerospace supply chain. If authentic, exposure of internal repositories could enable intellectual property theft and infrastructure targeting. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #SEKISUIAerospace #ITAR #Boeing #DefenseIndustry #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity

posts.text: ⚠️ Threat Actor Claims Sale of 176M Starbucks User Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor is offering a database containing 176 million unique Starbucks user records for sale. The seller claims to have successfully extracted the data in June 2026 and is listing the database for $400. The post includes sample lines demonstrating the breadth of the alleged breach, which reportedly spans multiple countries including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, France, Germany, and Spain. According to the listing, the exposed dataset contains highly sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and financial details. The sample data provided in the thread indicates the following fields are included: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt format) * name * country_code and country * city * created_at and last_activity_at * account_status * email_verified * birthday * stars_balance and stars_lifetime * total_spent * currency_code * starbucks_card_number * card_balance * auto_reload_enabled * favorite_store_number * favorite_drink * mobile_orders_count * free_rewards_redeemed * signup_platform Starbucks is one of the world's largest coffeehouse chains, with over 38,000 stores globally and a massive digital loyalty program. The exposure of such a large volume of user data, including hashed passwords and linked payment card numbers, could facilitate credential stuffing attacks, identity theft, and targeted phishing campaigns against customers. If authentic, the inclusion of specific spending habits and favorite drinks adds a layer of personalization that could enhance social engineering efforts. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Starbucks or third-party security researchers. The company has not issued any public statements regarding this specific incident. #DataBreach #Starbucks #DarkWeb #PII #CredentialLeak #CyberSecurity #RetailSecurity

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 90M Just Eat Records Leaked on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that a database containing 90 million records from Just Eat has been exposed. The actor alleges that the data belongs to Just Eat http://Takeaway.com, the multinational food delivery platform that operates across Europe and other regions. The post includes a sample of the alleged dump, which appears to contain user credentials and financial details. According to the listing, the exposed dataset includes the following fields: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt format) * name * country * currency_code * account_type * member_since * email_verified * payment_method * card_last4 (last four digits of credit/debit cards) * payout_method * platform and app_version * last_active timestamp * account_status The sample records provided in the thread show users from various countries, including the US, UK, Spain, France, Canada, Italy, and Mexico. The entries include full names, email addresses, hashed passwords, and partial payment card numbers. Some records also indicate donation histories and campaign details, which may suggest the data originates from a crowdfunding or donation feature associated with the platform or a related service. Just Eat http://Takeaway.com is one of the largest food delivery companies globally, with millions of active users. If authentic, the exposure of 90 million user records including password hashes and payment card fragments could facilitate credential stuffing attacks, phishing campaigns, and identity theft. The bcrypt hashes are computationally expensive to crack but remain vulnerable if users have reused weak passwords. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Just Eat http://Takeaway.com or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Live Admin Access to Brazil's 300M-Record Health Database A post on an underground forum alleges that a threat actor has obtained live administrative access to Brazil’s national health and medical registry, purportedly containing over 300 million records. The listing claims the actor possesses full privileges to query, view, edit, and modify patient data in real-time, including residential addresses, family linkages, and complete historical vaccination records. According to the forum post, the actor is offering this access for sale at a price of $200, payable in Bitcoin, Monero, or Ethereum. The capabilities listed in the advertisement include: * Instant querying of the entire population by name, CPF (Brazilian individual taxpayer registry), state, and other identifiers * Access to full patient profiles with residential addresses and maternal/paternal linkage data * Complete historical vaccination records * Full administrative control to view, edit, and modify records in real-time The Brazilian Ministry of Health manages one of the largest public healthcare systems in the world through the Unified Health System (SUS), which serves the entire population of approximately 215 million people. The alleged exposure of such granular personal health information on a national scale would represent a significant privacy violation if the claims are authentic. If verified, the ability to modify medical records could have severe implications for public health tracking and individual patient care. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach and the authenticity of the claimed administrative access have not been independently verified by security researchers or official authorities. #DataBreach #Brazil #HealthcareSecurity #DarkWeb #PII #Ransomware #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 300M Brazilian Health Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post alleges the unauthorized sale of administrative access to Brazil’s SUS (Unified Health System) and CADSUS databases, purportedly exposing over 300 million records. The listing claims that the seller possesses full query, edit, add, and delete capabilities within the system, allowing for searches by name, CPF (Brazilian individual taxpayer registry), state, and parental information. According to the post, the exposed data includes sensitive personal details such as: - Residential addresses - Parental information - Full vaccination history The actor is reportedly offering this access for $140, directing interested parties to a Telegram channel for proof and further inquiries. The SUS is Brazil’s public healthcare system, serving nearly the entire population of over 210 million people, making it one of the largest health networks in the world. A breach of this scale would represent a massive compromise of national health infrastructure. If authentic, exposure of internal repositories could enable intellectual property theft and infrastructure targeting. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified. #DataBreach #SUS #Brazil #Healthcare #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 300M Uber User Records on Darkweb A post on an underground forum alleges the exposure of a database containing over 300 million Uber user records, which the actor is reportedly offering for sale. The listing, dated July 17, 2026, claims to include sensitive personal information for both riders and drivers across multiple countries. According to the post, the dataset includes the following fields: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt) * name * phone * gender * city and country * account_type (rider/driver) * rating and total_trips * member_since and last_trip_at * payment_method and card_last4 * platform and app_version * account_status * vehicle_make, vehicle_model, vehicle_year, vehicle_class * license_plate * driver_license_no * driver_status * lifetime_earnings_usd The sample data provided in the thread shows entries from users in the United States, France, Mexico, Brazil, Spain, and the United Kingdom. For driver accounts, the alleged leak includes personally identifiable information such as license plate numbers, driver license numbers, and lifetime earnings in USD. Rider accounts allegedly contain email addresses, hashed passwords, phone numbers, and the last four digits of payment cards. Uber Technologies Inc. is a major global ride-hailing and delivery platform with hundreds of millions of active users worldwide. A breach of this scale would represent a significant compromise of user privacy and potentially expose financial data if password hashes are cracked or if card details are misused. The actor claims the complete dataset is available for $500 via a private messaging session. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Uber or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 95M Uber Eats User Records Leaked on Darkweb A post on an underground forum alleges the exposure of over 95 million user records from Uber Eats, the food delivery arm of Uber. The listing claims to contain a comprehensive database of customer and courier information, including personally identifiable information (PII), financial details, and behavioral data. According to the sample data provided in the thread, the alleged leak includes the following fields: * User IDs, emails, and password hashes (bcrypt) * Full names, phone numbers, and genders * Detailed delivery addresses, including city, postal code, country, and GPS coordinates * Payment method types and last four digits of credit cards * Account activity metrics such as total orders, average order value, and favorite cuisines * Courier-specific data including vehicle type, delivery counts, ratings, and earnings The sample entries appear to cover users from multiple countries, including the United States, Brazil, Mexico, the United Kingdom, France, Spain, and Italy. The data reportedly spans account creation dates from as early as 2015 to recent activity in 2025. If authentic, the exposure of such granular location and financial data could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns, identity theft, and physical security risks for both customers and delivery drivers. Uber is a multinational technology company operating in more than 70 countries. A breach of this scale would represent a significant incident for the organization, potentially triggering regulatory scrutiny under GDPR and other data protection laws due to the inclusion of EU citizen data. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Uber or third-party security researchers.

posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Group-IB identified at least 12 compromised systems carrying #HOLLOWGRAPH, with only three actively communicating with attacker infrastructure during the observation period. posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: HOLLOWGRAPH supports only two commands, "get" and "send", yet maintains persistence of its cloud communications through DNS tunneling. Using specially crafted IPv6 AAAA queries to cloudlanecdn[.]com, the malware refreshes Microsoft Entra ID credentials required to authenticate to its Microsoft Graph-based C2 channel. #MalwareAnalysis
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：HOLLOWGRAPH 僅支援兩個命令“獲取”和“發送”，但透過 DNS 隧道保持其雲端通訊的持久性。此惡意軟體使用特製的 IPv6 AAAA 查詢 cloudlanecdn[.]com，刷新對基於 Microsoft Graph 的 C2 通道進行身份驗證所需的 Microsoft Entra ID 憑證。 #惡意軟體分析

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Instead of using traditional C2 infrastructure, #HOLLOWGRAPH stores operator tasking and stolen data inside calendar events scheduled for 13 May 2050. The implant retrieves commands from encrypted attachments and uploads exfiltrated files back to the same mailbox as File{n}.txt attachments, using separate RSA key pairs and AES-256-GCM encryption for each communication direction. Defenders should hunt for calendar events with Event ID: <taskid> {} subjects or the Boss{}ID{} naming convention. #ThreatIntel #APT
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#HOLLOWGRAPH 不使用傳統的 C2 基礎設施，而是將操作員任務和被盜資料儲存在計畫於 2050 年 5 月 13 日的日曆事件中。植入程式從加密附件中檢索命令，並將洩漏的檔案上傳回與 File{n}.txt 附件相同的郵箱，每個通訊方向使用單獨的 RSA 金鑰對和 AES-256-GCM 加密。防禦者應尋找具有事件 ID 的日曆事件：<taskid> {} 主題或 Boss{}ID{} 命名約定。 #威脅英特爾#APT

posts.text: ⚠️ When two "medium-looking" vulnerabilities meet, the outcome isn't always medium. The recently disclosed wp2shell chain is a good example of why vulnerabilities should be evaluated as attack paths rather than isolated CVEs. A REST API authorization bypass (CVE-2026-63030) removes the authentication barrier. A separate SQL injection (CVE-2026-60137) suddenly becomes reachable. Neither issue tells the full story on its own, but together they can lead to administrative compromise and, ultimately, remote code execution. What makes this case stand out is that the vulnerabilities affect WordPress Core, not a third-party plugin or theme. In our latest blog, we explain: • How the exploit chain works • Which WordPress versions are affected • Why the combined risk is much higher than the individual CVSS scores suggest • What defenders should verify after applying the patches If you're responsible for WordPress environments, this is worth reviewing. ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-critical-rce-chain #WordPress #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 當兩個「中等」的漏洞相遇時，結果並不總是中等。最近揭露的 wp2shell 鍊是一個很好的例子，說明了為什麼漏洞應該被評估為攻擊路徑而不是孤立的 CVE。 REST API 授權繞過 (CVE-2026-63030) 消除了身分驗證障礙。突然可以存取單獨的 SQL 注入 (CVE-2026-60137)。這兩個問題本身都無法說明全部問題，但它們結合起來可能會導致管理妥協，並最終導致遠端程式碼執行。這個案例之所以引人注目，是因為這些漏洞影響的是 WordPress 核心，而不是第三方外掛或主題。在我們最新的部落格中，我們解釋了： • 漏洞利用鍊如何運作 • 哪些 WordPress 版本受到影響 • 為什麼綜合風險遠高於單一 CVSS 分數建議的風險 • 應用修補程式後防禦者應驗證哪些內容 如果您負責 WordPress 環境，則值得查看。 ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-ritic-rce-chain #WordPress #Cyber​​Security #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE

posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 當兩個「中等」的漏洞相遇時，結果並不總是中等。最近揭露的 wp2shell 鍊是一個很好的例子，說明了為什麼漏洞應該被評估為攻擊路徑而不是孤立的 CVE。 REST API 授權繞過 (CVE-2026-63030) 消除了身分驗證障礙。突然可以存取單獨的 SQL 注入 (CVE-2026-60137)。這兩個問題本身都無法說明全部問題，但它們結合起來可能會導致管理妥協，並最終導致遠端程式碼執行。這個案例之所以引人注目，是因為這些漏洞影響的是 WordPress 核心，而不是第三方外掛或主題。在我們最新的部落格中，我們解釋了： • 漏洞利用鍊如何運作 • 哪些 WordPress 版本受到影響 • 為什麼綜合風險遠高於單一 CVSS 分數建議的風險 • 應用修補程式後防禦者應驗證哪些內容 如果您負責 WordPress 環境，則值得查看。 ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-ritic-rce-chain #WordPress #Cyber​​Security #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 4M São Paulo Student Records A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor known as 'Confia Company' is allegedly selling a database containing personal information of over 4 million students from the São Paulo State Department of Education (SEDUC-SP). The listing, posted on July 16, 2026, claims the data was extracted directly from the API of 'Sala do Futuro,' the official educational platform used by the state's public school system. According to the post, the dataset covers approximately 1,480 cities within São Paulo state and includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) for each student. The alleged exposed fields include: * Student ID and RA (Registration Number) * Full name * CPF (Brazilian national ID) and RG (state ID) * Date of birth and gender * Email addresses * Parents' full names * Complete home addresses (street, number, neighborhood, ZIP code, city, state) * Geolocation coordinates (latitude/longitude) * Class enrollment details The listing provides sample records showing data for students in cities such as São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Araraquara, and São Caetano do Sul, confirming the presence of CPFs, parent names, and precise address details. The actor invites interested buyers to contact them via Telegram or Session for pricing. São Paulo State is the largest education system in Brazil, serving millions of students annually. The exposure of such granular data, including geolocation and national identification numbers, poses significant risks of identity theft, social engineering, and physical safety threats to minors and their families. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by SEDUC-SP or security researchers. #DataBreach #EducationSecurity #Brazil #SaoPaulo #PII #DarkWeb #StudentData
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱出售 400 萬份聖保羅學生記錄 一篇暗網論壇帖子透露，一個名為“Confia Company”的威脅行為者涉嫌出售包含聖保羅州教育部 (SEDUC-SP) 超過 400 萬學生個人信息的數據庫。該清單發佈於 2026 年 7 月 16 日，聲稱數據直接從該州公立學校系統使用的官方教育平台「Sala do Futuro」的 API 中提取。根據該帖子，該資料集涵蓋聖保羅州內約 1,480 個城市，並包含每個學生的敏感個人識別資訊 (PII)。據稱暴露的欄位包括： * 學生 ID 和 RA（註冊號碼） * 全名 * CPF（巴西國民 ID）和 RG（州 ID） * 出生日期和性別 * 電子郵件地址 * 父母的全名 * 完整的家庭住址（街道、號碼、社區、郵政編碼、城市、州） * 地理位置座標（緯度/經度） * 班級註冊資訊該清單提供了範例記錄，顯示了聖若澤多斯坎普斯、聖奧多斯坎普斯等城市的學生資料聖保羅、阿拉拉誇拉和南聖卡埃塔諾，確認 CPF 的存在、父母姓名和準確的地址詳細資料。演員邀請有興趣的買家透過 Telegram 或 Session 與他們聯繫以獲取定價。聖保羅州是巴西最大的教育系統，每年為數百萬名學生提供服務。此類精細資料（包括地理位置和國民身分證號碼）的暴露會為未成年人及其家人帶來身分盜竊、社會工程和人身安全威脅的重大風險。截至報告時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到 SEDUC-SP 或安全研究人員的獨立驗證。 #DataBreach #EducationSecurity #巴西 #SaoPaulo #PII #DarkWeb #StudentData

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The #malware targets 8 browsers, 31 #cryptowallet extensions, 7 password managers, and 8 desktop wallet applications. Using a modular architecture, ClickLock Stealer employs a GSocket backdoor installer disguised as iCloud, a credential stealer, Keychain stealer, and crypto-focused harvester that extracts #blockchain addresses across 6 chains. All components exfiltrate data via #Telegram Bot API, while the backdoor provides persistent remote access.
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：#malware 的目標是 8 個瀏覽器、31 個 #cryptowallet 擴充功能、7 個密碼管理器和 8 個桌面錢包應用程式。 ClickLock Stealer 採用模組化架構，採用偽裝成 iCloud 的 GSocket 後門安裝程式、憑證竊取程式、鑰匙圈竊取程式和以加密貨幣為中心的收割機，可跨 6 個鏈提取 #blockchain 位址。所有元件都透過#Telegram Bot API 竊取數據，而後門則提供持久的遠端存取。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: #ClickLockStealer implements a layered approach to credential theft. If a victim enters their password willingly, the attack completes in seconds. If they refuse, the #malware installs LaunchAgents for persistence and activates a kill-loop terminating Finder, Dock, SystemUIServer, and Terminal every 210 milliseconds, leaving only a fake password dialog on screen until #compliance is achieved. The same coercion technique forces approval of a macOS Keychain authorization prompt to extract Chrome's Safe Storage AES key.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#ClickLockStealer 實作了一種分層的憑證竊取方法。如果受害者自願輸入密碼，攻擊將在幾秒鐘內完成。如果他們拒絕，#malware 會安裝 LaunchAgents 以實現持久性，並每 210 毫秒啟動一個終止循環，終止 Finder、Dock、SystemUIServer 和終端，只在螢幕上留下一個假密碼對話框，直到實作 #compliance。同樣的強制技術會強制批准 macOS 鑰匙圈授權提示，以擷取 Chrome 的安全儲存 AES 金鑰。

posts.text: A new #macOS stealer named #ClickLockStealer has been discovered with zero detections on VirusTotal, targeting users across Europe, North America, and MEA. The attack chain requires no exploits or elevated privileges to succeed. #ThreatIntel

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The primary vector for ScatteredSpider’s initial access is highly targeted social engineering, but it relies on a specific toolset to exploit human trust. Subclusters deploy sophisticated #phishing kits that mimic Okta, Microsoft, and Citrix login pages, sometimes only kept online for a few minutes during a phone call. Our deep dive reveals how these attacks are orchestrated, combining vishing and smishing techniques to direct victims to credential-harvesting sites before delivering a #RAT or other payload.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：ScatteredSpider 初始訪問的主要向量是高度針對性的社會工程，但它依賴於特定的工具集來利用人類信任。子叢集部署複雜的 #phishing 工具包，模仿 Okta、Microsoft 和 Citrix 登入頁面，有時僅在通話期間保持線上幾分鐘。我們深入研究了這些攻擊是如何精心策劃的，結合了語音釣魚和網路釣魚技術，在傳遞 #RAT 或其他有效負載之前將受害者引導至憑證收集網站。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Our analysis shows that Scattered Spider subclusters consistently target employees of major identity providers and marketing platforms like Twilio and Mailchimp as a stepping stone. The end goal is rarely the initial victim; it's to leverage internal tools for phishing campaigns against #cryptocurrency users. Simultaneous operations targeting #Okta login pages and crypto wallets prove the primary objective across these independent subclusters remains financial gain through crypto theft.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：我們的分析表明，分散的蜘蛛子集群始終以主要身份提供商和營銷平台（如 Twilio 和 Mailchimp）的員工作為墊腳石。最終目標很少是最初的受害者；它是利用內部工具針對#cryptocurrency 用戶進行網路釣魚活動。針對 #Okta 登入頁面和加密錢包的同時操作證明，這些獨立子集群的主要目標仍然是透過加密盜竊獲得經濟利益。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Beyond digital #socialengineering, one ScatteredSpider subcluster has been observed resorting to physical theft, specifically stealing employee iPads from mobile carrier retail stores. To bypass device locks, attackers would impersonate internal departments to socially engineer the passcode from store staff. This hybrid physical-digital tactic highlights the lengths these subclusters will go to for SIM swapping operations, targeting telco employees and authorized retailers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile. #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：除了數字#socialengineering 之外，還觀察到一個 ScatteredSpider 子集群採取物理盜竊手段，特別是從移動運營商零售店竊取員工的 iPad。為了繞過設備鎖，攻擊者會冒充內部部門，對商店員工的密碼進行社會設計。這種實體-數位混合策略凸顯了這些子叢集將在 SIM 交換作業上花費大量時間，目標是電信員工和 Verizon、AT&T 和 T-Mobile 等授權零售商。 #威脅情報

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: Recent research reveals that #ScatteredSpider is not a singular organized group but a decentralized #cybercrime collective comprised of multiple, independent subclusters. This loose affiliation of operators, connected primarily through shared TTPs and social engineering techniques, poses a unique challenge for attribution. Our latest analysis explains how this structure, akin to a hacking movement, provides inherent resilience against #lawenforcement actions. It's not a single group to track, but a persistent culture of cybercrime that evolves continuously.
posts.text_zh: 最近的研究表明，#ScatteredSpider 並不是一個單一的有組織團體，而是由多個獨立子集群組成的去中心化的#cybercrime 集體。營運商的這種鬆散聯繫（主要透過共享 TTP 和社會工程技術進行連接）對歸因提出了獨特的挑戰。我們的最新分析解釋了這種類似於駭客運動的結構如何提供針對#lawenforcement 行動的固有彈性。它不是一個需要追蹤的單一群體，而是一種持續發展的持續網路犯罪文化。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #MilleniumRAT (v4.x) marks a significant evolution in the threat landscape. The #malware has been completely rewritten from .NET to a native C++ application, removing .NET dependencies. This architectural shift enables greater stealth and resilience, making detection more challenging. The #Telegram Bot API remains the core C2 mechanism.
posts.text_zh: 固定：#MilleniumRAT (v4.x) 標誌著威脅格局的重大演變。 #malware 已從 .NET 完全重寫為本機 C++ 應用程序，刪除了 .NET 依賴項。這種架構轉變可實現更大的隱密性和彈性，使檢測更具挑戰性。 #Telegram Bot API 仍然是核心 C2 機制。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: How are threat actors combining session hijacking, browser profile cloning, HVNC, and cryptocurrency-focused tooling into a commercial Malware-as-a-Service offering? Our latest analysis of SilabRAT explores its infrastructure, ClickFix-driven infection chains, technical capabilities, and the threat actor behind its development. Read the full report: https://link.group-ib.com/4xluZub
posts.text_zh: R 向 @GroupIB_TI 提問：威脅行為者如何將會話劫持、瀏覽器設定檔複製、HVNC 和以加密貨幣為中心的工具結合到商業惡意軟體即服務產品中？我們對 SilabRAT 的最新分析探討了其基礎設施、ClickFix 驅動的感染鏈、技術能力及其開發背後的威脅參與者。閱讀完整報告：https://link.group-ib.com/4xluZub

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: SilabRAT places significant emphasis on #cryptocurrency theft. Beyond harvesting credentials and browser data, it can identify wallet-related artifacts and automatically attempt password recovery using credentials collected from infected systems. These additions reflect the growing focus on direct monetization within modern #malware ecosystems.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 非常重視#cryptocurrency 竊盜。除了收集憑證和瀏覽器資料之外，它還可以識別與錢包相關的工件，並使用從受感染系統收集的憑證自動嘗試恢復密碼。這些新增內容反映了現代#惡意軟體生態系統中對直接貨幣化的日益關注。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: One of SilabRAT's most notable capabilities is its use of Hidden Virtual Network Computing (HVNC). By interacting with services directly from the victim's device, attackers can perform account activity, access sensitive platforms, and conduct fraudulent operations while appearing as a legitimate user originating from the trusted device and IP address. #InfoSec
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 最顯著的功能之一是它使用隱藏虛擬網路運算 (HVNC)。透過直接從受害者的裝置與服務交互，攻擊者可以執行帳戶活動、存取敏感平台並進行詐騙操作，同時表現為來自受信任裝置和 IP 位址的合法使用者。 #資訊安全

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #SilabRAT is a newly emerging Malware-as-a-Service (#MaaS) platform developed by the threat actor "o1oo1" and advertised on underground forums since late 2025. Sold for $5,000 per month, the Remote Access Trojan (#RAT) combines credential theft, session hijacking, HVNC access, Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypasses using COM elevation, and cryptocurrency-focused tooling into a single platform built for financially motivated cybercrime.
posts.text_zh: #SilabRAT 是一個新興的惡意軟體即服務 (#MaaS) 平台，由威脅行為者「o1oo1」開發，自 2025 年底以來在地下論壇上做廣告。遠端存取木馬 (#RAT) 每月售價 5,000 美元，將憑證盜竊、會話劫持、HVNC 存取、使用 COM 提升的 Chrome 應用程式綁定加密繞過以及以加密貨幣為中心的工具整合到一個為出於經濟動機的網路犯罪。

posts.text: TeamT5 will be exhibiting at Cyber Defense Symposium Atami 2026, a premier event focused on defense and national security. As Japan continues to advance its Active Cyber Defense initiatives, proactive cybersecurity capabilities have become more critical than ever. At our booth, we will showcase our APAC-focused #ThreatIntelligence and #ThreatHunting solutions, designed to help organizations identify, understand, and respond to emerging cyber threats with greater speed and precision. 📅 June 20 (Sat.) ~ June 21 (Sun.) 📍 Atami Korakuen Hotel (Atami City, Shizuoka, Japan) 👉More details: https://www.5th-battlefield.com/ #5thbf @Battlefield5th
posts.text_zh: TeamT5 將參加 2026 年熱海網路防禦研討會，這是一場專注於國防和國家安全的重要活動。隨著日本不斷推進其主動網路防禦計劃，主動網路安全能力變得比以往任何時候都更加重要。在我們的展位上，我們將展示專注於亞太地區的#ThreatIntelligence 和#ThreatHunting 解決方案，旨在幫助組織更快、更精確地識別、理解和響應新興網路威脅。 📅6月20日（週六）~6月21日（週日）📍熱海後樂園飯店（日本靜岡縣熱海市）👉更多詳情：https://www.5th-battlefield.com/ #5thbf @Battlefield5th

posts.text: This made my day: Brazilian Authorities Will Revive Fraud Case Against George Santos. A 2008 court case had been suspended because Brazilian law enforcement officials could not find Mr. Santos. https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/02/nyregion/george-santos-brazil.html
posts.text_zh: 這讓我很高興：巴西當局將恢復針對喬治桑托斯的詐欺案。由於巴西執法官員找不到桑托斯先生，2008 年的一個法庭案件已被暫停。 https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/02/nyregion/george-santos-brazil.html

posts.text: R to @briankrebs: Turned off protected mode for a bit. Let the firehose commence.
posts.text_zh: R 致@briankrebs：暫時關閉保護模式。讓消防水帶開始。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Hey @elonmusk, since you don't seem to have much a media/comms team anymore, can you address the apparently legitimate claim that someone scraped & is now selling data on hundreds of millions of Twitter accounts? Maybe it didn't happen on your watch, but you owe Twitter a reply.
posts.text_zh: 嘿@elonmusk，既然你似乎不再有太多的媒體/通訊團隊，你能解決一下有人在數億個 Twitter 帳戶上抓取並出售數據的明顯合法的說法嗎？也許這不是在你手錶上發生的，但你欠 Twitter 一個回應。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Just enjoyed several glorious days when I didn't even think about Twitter. Wandered back just now to see what's new, and yep about what I expected.
posts.text_zh: 只是享受了幾天美好的時光，我什至沒有想到推特。剛才又回來看看有什麼新鮮事，是的，關於我所期望的。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: This article could easily be updated to reflect the current reason a lot of people here (particularly journalists) have their accounts locked: It slows the firehose of bot replies from gajillions of accounts that don't follow you. It's probably also come to mean FU to Twitter.
posts.text_zh: 這篇文章可以輕鬆更新，以反映當前許多人（尤其是記者）的帳戶被鎖定的原因：它減慢了來自無數不關注您的帳戶的機器人回复的速度。對 Twitter 來說，它也可能意味著 FU。
